scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/core packages/dom packages/react && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/demo && bun run typecheck:examples
scripts.docs:build: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.preversion: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && bun install && git add package.json packages/*/package.json apps/*/package.json examples/*/package.json bun.lock
scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc -p examples/socketio && tsc -p examples/signalr && tsc -p examples/bun-native && tsc -p examples/node-ws && tsc -p examples/hono && tsc -p examples/elysia
